notes.title: Removal on the Steam store
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

after a lot of reflection, I decided to remove the game on Steam as soon as possible. I have thought of remaking the game a lot of time but it will be so time consuming and I think the result won't be worth it. The game will be freely available on my blog instead. Sadly, it was clearly a mistake to make it a commercial game, as this game is really amateurish and doesn't deserve to be on the Steam store. It is a complete waste of time to play it as there are so many awesome games coming out everyday on Steam. I will give my all to finish Clarent Saga: Tactics (my other game) and deliver the best possible game I can.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

notes.title: Clairification about the free status of the game.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I am actually confused with the current status of the game. It is currently free to play but you can still buy it (because of the commercial license I think).

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

Edit: you can't make a game free and make a buying option. I guess it will be free then.

notes.title: The game will be free instead of removed from the steam store!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

first I would like to apologize for changing my mind so often. So I have decided that the game will be free instead of removed from the steam store. I hope people who has bought it recently can get a refund.

I have changed my mind because of the kind support and comments I have received from gamers. I am working extra hard on Clarent Saga Tactics and trust me: it will be truly an amazing game when I will release the last version!

As a gamer, I felt that The Peloran Wars is a bad game. But as a creator, it really helped me grow and learn from my past mistakes so it will always have a special place in my heart.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

notes.title: Removal on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I will completely remove Crimson Sword Saga: The Peloran Wars from the Steam store. Indeed, even if I have put a lot of effort into creating this game, the game is really bad and does not meet my standards. And in my humble opinion, this game has no place on Steam.

Best regards,
David N.

notes.title: Final version
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I guess this is it for this game! In my opinion, it is a really bad game and not worth someone's time, still I think this is an "interesting" prototype for Clarent Saga: Tactics.

Regards,
David Nguyen.

PS: the only nice thing about this game is the trading cards. You have been warned!

notes.title: I wanted to make the game free but...
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

In all honesty I found this first game quite bad and it does not have the quality that one can expect from a commercial game. But as bad as it may is, I have worked 3 years on this game and I don't regret it. Just don't expect a good game and see it as a draft for CSS: Tactics. Nevertheless I will keep it at a low price because I can't keep Steam trading cards if I make it free.

Concerning Tower of Brax (another RPG Maker game), the game has been discontinued. It was way too generic and I don't want to pollute Steam anymore. Sadly there are now way too many bad (or downright mediocre) games on this platform. There is a download link of this project on my blog: http://crimsonswordsaga.blogspot.fr

Sincerely,
David N.

notes.title: v2.1
notes.content:
Hi,

I have made numerous little changes.
Here are the major changes:

- Cheats are now hidden: press S (keyboard) or LB (Xbox controller) to access it
- chapter select and fight select are considered as cheats
- fight select are normal fights (no escape and gameover when defeat)
- add a secret shop with holy weapons as cheats, these are C rank so everyone can equip them
- after the ending, the game propose to go to bonus chapter
- The option to gain exp and gold when skipping are turn to off by default.
- Jezebel fight is harder.

Some notes:

To win the bonus chapter fights, you may use the secret shop.
Fastest way to gain exp and gold:
use chapter select (cheats) and go to bonus 2, turn on the option to gain exp and gold when skipping fight and then pass the chapter, you will gain around 1000 exp and 7000 gold. Repeat as much as you like.

notes.title: v2 version
notes.content:
Hi folks! Some users had concerns about difficulty and cheats, and here is a major update.

- Most of the cheats has been removed. 
- A lot of suplerfuous options has been removed
so it is less confusing.
- The game is considerably harder but you can toggle difficulty
between: very easy, easy, normal, hard and very hard.

People who play for the story should play in Very easy
(it is easy but not too much).
Normal mode can be pretty chalenging too.
Some fights in Very hard may be really difficult to win.

I wanted to include many options and cheats so player
can freely adapt their playstyle but it was really confusing.
Now this version is how the game was intended to be played.

Enjoy!
